Thank you for considering being a part of our team. We deeply appreciate your support and enthusiasm.

notes.title: ScrewUp 1.0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Official Game Update Announcement:[/b][/h2]

"Introducing the ScrewUp 1.0.5.0 update! We are excited to bring you new content and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Explore the new Prasat Island, inhabited by three new elemental monsters. Dive into challenging battles as you progress through different areas based on the time of day. Discover rare loot dropped by high-level monsters, allowing you to create and awaken powerful weapons.

We've also introduced two new treasure chests in Prasat Island, each requiring a different number of keys to unlock. Additionally, the picturesque city of Brewen Beach awaits your arrival, offering various services, including weapon crafting and power awakening.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the latest update and have fun in the world of ScrewUp!"



[h2]ScrewUp 1.0.5.0 Update Patch Notes:[/h2]

Added a new area: "Prasat Island."

Added 3 new elemental monsters.

Monsters at levels 15-20 will only appear in the central area of Prasat Island during the daytime.

Monsters at levels 20-25 will be located in the beach camp surrounding Prasat Island.

Monsters at levels 25-30 will be found in Prasat Island during nighttime.

High-level monsters (level 30) have a chance to drop rare loot used for crafting and awakening weapons.

Two new treasure chests have been added to Prasat Island.

Regular treasure chest: Requires 5 keys to open.
Golden treasure chest: Requires 10 keys to open.
Added a new city, "Brewen Beach," to the game.

Introduced NPCs that allow players to craft weapons and awaken their power.

Added an NPC that sells basic weapon blueprints (can also be obtained from chests or monsters in Prasat Island).

Fixed various bugs and issues.

notes.title: ScrewUp 1.0.2.7 Official Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40895668/98490fcf2531d5330d3edb159794cf1b51cb1c9f.jpg[/img][b]ScrewUp 1.0.2.7 Official Update Announcement[/img][/b]

We are excited to introduce new features that will make the building system in ScrewUp even more fluid and efficient. Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Destroying a modular part of a house with a mallet will now refund approximately 50% of the materials used to build it.
[*] Removing non-house modular parts such as workbenches, chests, beds, etc. will return the item as an item that can be placed in a new location.
[*] If a building part is destroyed or removed, any items stored in its inventory will drop to the ground.
[*] These new features will save time and streamline the building process for players. The update will be available today.
[/list]

In addition to the building improvements, we have also added the following features:

[list]
[*] Crafting recipes for iron torches and wall-mounted lights for your character's home.
[*] Research table to craft iron weapons.
[*] New mining area in a nearby abandoned village, complete with level 10 monsters and loot drops for crafting new weapons.
[*] Multiple new crafting recipes for weapons.
[/list]

notes.title: Screwup 1.0.1.6 Update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to inform you that a new update for Screwup is now available, version 1.0.1.6. This update includes several changes and improvements to the game, which we believe will enhance your gameplay experience.

Firstly, we have removed the camp gate in the Beach Ruins zone. This area will now serve as the location for early-level farming and monster hunting during nighttime. Previously, players had to destroy the gate themselves and clear out the area, but now it will be accessible from the start.

Secondly, we have adjusted the durability of weapons and equipment to make them more appropriate for their respective tiers. We have also increased the speed and power of certain weapons and equipment to make them more viable in combat.

We hope these changes will provide a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support of Screwup.

notes.title: Quick update on the new version
notes.content:
New system that will be available in version 1.0:

1. Day-night cycle system - It will affect the world in many ways, such as monster spawn time or different wild animals at night. Hunting will give more rewards but will be more dangerous. The lighting in the city at night will vary according to the zone.

2. Breakable objects - Players and monsters can destroy many objects in the game such as tables, chairs, cabinets, and many more.

3. For the first version of the new update, there will be a large main zone that is separated into three smaller zones as follows:

- The city zone will have various houses and buildings to explore inside and find items in every house.
- The forest zone will be a source for hunting and finding water sources. The use of drinking water sources is limited, and if it is used up, players will have to wait for a new source of drinking water to emerge or find a new source of drinking water. In the forest, there will be many more buildings to explore throughout the forest.
- The old village zone will be a spawning place for dangerous monsters, and there will be rare items that can only be found there. The items will change according to the time of day and night.

notes.title: ScrewUp Patch Note version 0.4.1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40895668/83f4427c86202be422e40f4cb1c9d2844a1ffedb.png[/img]

[h1][b]ScrewUp Patch Note version 0.4.1.3  [18/10/2021] “The New World”[/b][/h1]

[h2]Greetings!! [/h2]

We’re happy to announce that the ScrewUp version 0.4.1.3 is now live!
So you may ask “what is so special about this version?” In this new version we have added a lot of new content into the game ,for example ; new islands to explore, new weapons to craft and new monsters to fight etc. For more details please see below.

[h2]New Islands :[/h2] The island is now an entire archipelago. The new total landmass is at least 10 times larger than that of the previous version. The archipelago consists of many islands, some of these will come with different biomes such as desert or mountain with monsters and natural resources that are unique to that biome.

[h2]New Resource :[/h2] Trees and Ores that found all over the archipelago now have many grades Such as Softwood, Wood, Hardwood, Ironwood and Lastly Crystalwood.

[h2]New Enemy :[/h2] More than 10 new types of enemies that can be found all across the islands. The deeper you go into the archipelago, the more powerful monsters you will encounter. More monsters will be added later on, so be prepared.

[h2]New Equipment :[/h2] All existing equipment, weapons/armors are reworked and now will use different material to craft. Some equipment will require items from specific monsters in order to craft them. This also applies to brand new equipment and weapons.

[h2]New Boss Monster :[/h2] Some new monsters that you will encounter in this version are Bosses. These baddies can withstand a lot of punishments. They may seem very hard to takedown alone, but with your friend by your side, nothing imposible! The reward from taking down one of these bosses is crafting material for the powerful weapons or armors.

[h2]New Character Progression :[/h2] Now all player’s levels are capped at 30, for now... Players will get 2 stats points in each level. New attributes [Handicraft] now available,this attribute increases character efficiency to gather resources.

[h2]New Range Weapons :[/h2] Beside melee weapons, now we add a wide range of long range weapons in our arsenal for players to choose. From a small pistol, to a devastating grenade launcher.

New Respawn system : The respawn point is now random at the outer edge of the archipelago in case you do not have an activated bed or camp. 

[h2]Revamp Death Penalty:[/h2] Death is now a lot more severe, you may loss all of your expirence point in your current level upon dead. Stay alive, don’t screw up (Pun intended)

[b]The Last thing we want to announce is about the game price. After consideration we decided to change the game price to reflect the increasing of its content. For players that have supported us before you will get this update for free, we’re grateful for your support and we will continue to keep improving our game.[/b]

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 0.3+
notes.content:
Hello! this is ScrewUp Dev team 

We want to announce that the game version 0.3.2 is now up and running on the Playtest.
This version will mainly include the revamp of the character creation system. But unfortunately, this new version is incompatible with the old savefile. We recommend players to create a brand new savefile in order to play the new version. In case the player wants to continue playing the old savefile, you just have to play the normal version of the game. To access the new version, players need to swap the game file to the beta version. notes.title: Update 0.2.4 & Compensation
notes.content:
We apologize for the inconvenience of the lost inventory data that happened to some of the players. To compensate for this, we have added a treasure chest with various items inside. You can find this treasure chest near the first practice dummy. This treasure chest will only exist for 24 hours after the update. We’re really sorry for the inconvenience.
ps. The Goblin is back!!

In the compensation treasure chest you will found
- Gold coin x3000
- Gold ingot x30
- Iron ingot x60
- Plank x120
- Red drink x100

*To divide items, Hold [Shift] then drag&drop item to divide by half. Hold [CTRL] to divide only one.
